description: This file defines an internal interface IResourceSelector<T> within the Orleans.Streams namespace, used for selecting a set of resources from a list, with functionality to get the count of resources and to select a subset without overlapping previous selections.

classes.name: IResourceSelector<T>
classes.description: An interface for selecting resources of type T from a resource list, including methods for counting resources and selecting a non-overlapping subset.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Property that returns the number of resources.

methods.name: NextSelection
methods.description: Method to select a specified number of resources that do not overlap with existing selections.
